title: Foresight plugin telemetry event
description: Payload for POST /ui/api/telemetry/event. Privacy contract: scalar fields only — never memory content, titles (unless opted in), or bodies. See plugins/telemetry/README.md.

event.description: Event name from the catalog, e.g. recall.injected, capture.stored, plugin.health

surface.description: Agent surface the event came from, e.g. 'claude-code', 'hooks'

latency_ms.description: End-to-end latency of the action being reported, when known

fields.description: Sanitized scalar extras only. Strings truncated server-side to 128 chars; nested objects are dropped. Suggested keys: memories_injected, memories_stored, blocks_injected, gated, top_score, threshold, error_kind, tokens_est.
